subject: MAP: Fabrx evaluation assets — one-week sandbox & return
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@fabrx.com>, Tom Hale <tom.hale@fabrx.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Fabrx evaluation assets — one-week sandbox & return

Hi Lina / Tom,

Thanks again for the conversation today — good alignment on scope. Attached is a draft mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the proposed handoff of evaluation assets (prompt pack + testcases + a small sample dataset) into a one-week ephemeral sandbox. Key asks here are:

- 1-week sandbox (start window: first business day after signature)
- Data residency: US-only sandbox (we'll provision in us-west)
- Usage constraints: no re-sharing, no production training; model outputs can be used for internal evaluation only
- Post-sandbox: Fabrx deletes assets and provides a signed confirmation (Redwood will provide a simple destruction confirmation template)

Please review the timeline in the attached PDF and confirm any compliance needs we should account for. I also included an eval_samples_list.csv with the specific files we'd exchange so we can lock access controls.

Attachments: [Redwood-Fabrx-MAP-draft.pdf], [eval_samples_list.csv] 

If that looks reasonable, can you confirm availability for the runway below so we can include dates in the MAP?

- Sign-off by Fri 2026-08-28
- Asset handoff Mon 2026-08-31 (provisioning and access)
- Sandbox closes Mon 2026-09-07 (assets removed)

Quick note on security: we can gate access behind a short-lived token and require IP allowlist; if you need a more formal checklist, Karthik is the best point.

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
[hannah.schmitt@redwood.com]

From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@fabrx.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hale <tom.hale@fabrx.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP: Fabrx evaluation assets — one-week sandbox & return

Hannah — thanks for the doc and the clear timeline. A couple quick clarifications before we sign: 

1) Usage constraints: Fabrx legal wants explicit language that Redwood will not retain a copy beyond the sandbox period and that model vendors used during eval cannot ingest the dataset for training. Is Redwood comfortable adding that clause?

2) Sample set size: the eval_samples_list.csv looks fine but we'll need to redact any PII before handoff. We'll do that on our side and upload a sanitized version. Can you confirm the exact acceptance checklist so our QA knows what to produce?

3) On the security questionnaire: we'll need Azure AD SSO integration details and the encryption-in-transit assurances. Tom and I will loop in our security lead if needed.

Assuming those items are addressed we can target Fri 2026-08-28 for sign-off.

Best,
Lina
Director of Data Science | Fabrx

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@fabrx.com>, Tom Hale <tom.hale@fabrx.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Fabrx evaluation assets — one-week sandbox & return

Lina — great questions, short answers below and attached the security questionnaire pre-filled where we could (see security_questionnaire.xlsx).

1) Retention/training: Redwood will not retain a copy of the Fabrx-provided assets beyond the agreed sandbox window. We will also include the clause preventing vendors from using the materials to continue training models. I added suggested language in the PDF (page 2).

2) Acceptance checklist: minimal acceptance items — file list matches eval_samples_list.csv, no PII flagged by your QA redaction, checksum verification on upload, and sandbox access test (login + token). I'll paste the checklist below for quick reference:
   - Sanitize files (no PII)
   - Upload to secure staging link (S3 presigned)
   - Confirm checksums in reply
   - Redwood performs automated scan and grants access token

3) Azure AD SSO & encryption: We support Azure AD SSO via SAML and all traffic in the sandbox is TLS1.2+. Karthik has the integration notes in the attached spreadsheet.

Attachments: [Redwood-Fabrx-MAP-draft.pdf], [security_questionnaire.xlsx] 

If that all looks good, we will update the MAP with final language and send for signature. 

—Hannah

On Tue, 25 Aug 2026 at 09:22, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@fabrx.com> wrote:
> Hannah — thanks for the doc and the clear timeline. A couple quick clarifications before we sign: ...

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: MAP final tweaks and cutover ops

Hannah / Priya — quick internal note to capture ops items before we finalize the MAP and DocuSign flow: 

- We will provision an ephemeral bucket per Fabrx trial with a 7-day lifecycle rule and server-side encryption (AES-256).
- Access will be via short-lived presigned URLs (24h) and a scoped service account.
- We should require Fabrx to submit a signed deletion confirmation (template included) as part of acceptance; Legal prefers the confirmation be timestamped and emailed to security@redwood.com.
- For SSO: we already have the SAML metadata; Priya can handle the test connection on Mon 8/31.

@Priya — can you confirm the expected SLA for provisioning? I think we can do same-day for requests received before 11am PT.

Karthik
Head of Platform Security | Redwood Inference

From: Tom Hale <tom.hale@fabrx.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@fabrx.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP: Fabrx evaluation assets — one-week sandbox & return

Hannah / Lina — quick confirmation from Fabrx: we reviewed the updated language Hannah sent and are OK with the non-retention and non-training clauses. We will provide a sanitized eval_samples_list.csv by COB Tue 8/31.

We agree to the timeline below:
- Sign-off Fri 8/28 (in flight)
- Asset upload Tue 8/31 (Fabrx sanitized files)
- Sandbox window 8/31–9/07; Fabrx to confirm deletion via the supplied template by 9/08.

We'll proceed to get internal sign-off; Tom (cc'd) will confirm the security lead's availability for the SSO test on 8/31.

Thanks,
Tom Hale
VP, Platform Engineering | Fabrx
Attachments referenced by Fabrx: [eval_samples_list.csv (pending sanitized upload)]
